carla: FYI seeing a pretty consistent p99 staircase after short microbursts this morning (10-20s bursts). p95 OK but p99 jumps 3x. Logs + quick flame: kernel selector fell back to scalar kernel twice during the spike and KV miss rate went up ~6x.

ben: can you paste the numbers? how big were the bursts (rps), seq len distribution, and which model/kernels?

carla: approx 180-250 rps for ~12s, mostly short requests (avg toks ~48) but ~15% long tail >256. Model: rwin-70b-8k. Kernel probe shows prefer-vec path but fallback to `scalar_v1` at high concurrency. Excerpt:
```
2026-03-12T09:11:21Z selector: preferred_kernel=vec_opt
2026-03-12T09:11:22Z runtime: kernel_fallback=scalar_v1 reason=kv-cache-miss+cpu-sat
2026-03-12T09:11:22Z kvcache: miss_rate=0.62 -> evict_trigger
2026-03-12T09:11:23Z latency_p99=2330ms
```

perf-bot: snapshot: p50=45ms, p95=210ms, p99=2320ms, KV_hit=38%, active_workers=46/48, queue_depth=3-7 during spike :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alice: sounds like two amplifiers: (1) KV cold/miss pattern from microburst (we're seeing large eviction churn), (2) kernel selector hysteresis + fallback that forces slow path while autoscaler is slow to add new workers. Together they push a subset of requests onto hot scalar kernels -> tail.

david: autoscaler logs? scale-up lag around how long? if it's >10s that matches you. Also check prober cadence and bootstrap time for new worker (kv prewarm).

carla: scale-up lag measured ~9-14s (decision->new worker ready ~11s median), bootstrap prewarm for KV ~2.5s but cold kernel compile/choosing adds ~1.3s. So overall some requests land on slow path while new capacity is initializing.

ben: proposed quick mitigations:
- reduce kernel-selector hysteresis from 6s -> 1.5s so prober tries alternative faster
- add optimistic warm path: when we trigger scale-up, mark next N requests for fast-prefetch KV hints
- treat microbursts (<30s) specially: increase ephemeral burst_pool to 6% of nodes instead of 2% (fast path)

eva: for the medium term we should also tune microbatch heuristics: when sequence lengths are short-majority, favor wider microbatches even at cost of small p50 increase. That reduces per-token cost and avoids switching kernels under load.

carla: I like the optimistic warm path idea. Ben, do you have a config snippet we can test in staging?

ben: yes, quick config we can AB test (staging -> prod if green):
```json
{
  "kernel_selector": { "hysteresis_ms": 1500, "probe_samples": 3 },
  "autoscaler": { "burst_pool_pct": 6, "scale_up_cooldown_ms": 8000 },
  "kv": { "optimistic_prefetch": true, "prefetch_on_scale": 8 }
}
```

alice: note the scale_up_cooldown reduce to 8s is risky. we should pair with a staged rollout and an emergency rollback flag. I'll put a temporary override in staging only, run traffic replay.

david: I'll create a short e2e test that replays recorded microburst at 220 rps for 15s and measures p99 over 2 minutes. Also will instrument kernel selection trace and kv-miss sequence per request.

carla: thanks. experiment plan:
- stage rollout with ben's config (staging only)
- replay traffic (david) x5, compare p99 distributions + KV hit ratio
- if p99 tail reduces >30% without p95 regressions, then can roll to canary 10% prod for 6 hours, watch cost/latency.

eva: also add a profiling hook to dump per-worker CPU/vmem once per spike so we can see whether scalar kernels cause higher CPU churn. small script: `curl /internal/metrics?spike=true`

ben: I'll implement the optimistic prefetch and hysteresis change. target: push to staging in next 2 hours.

infra-bot: deploy job started for `eng-runtime/kernel-hysteresis-prefetch` (build 2026.03.12-1132). Tracking: #deploy-5638

carla: great. after the first run, post the p99 numbers here and the kernel selection trace. if this helps we can roll to canary but we'll keep the scale_up_cooldown conservative in prod (maybe 10s) unless we see safety in staging. :thumbsup:

ben: will do. thanks all.

infra-bot: deploy job succeeded (build 2026.03.12-1132) in staging.

carla: experiment in progress (replay 1/5). ping when replay done.

david: replay 1 done. results: p99 down from 2320ms -> 1380ms, KV_hit up from 38% -> 62%, small p95 delta +12ms. attaching kernel trace snippet:
```
time kernel_choice: vec_opt vec_opt vec_opt vec_opt vec_opt 
post-change fallback events: 2 (vs 9 before)
```

carla: nice. please run remaining 4 and we can aggregate.

ben: running enhanced tracing and will post full results in ~40m.

carla: thanks everyone. if this keeps up we'll plan a canary tonight with conservative cooldown and burst pool bump.
